title: AgentPackage
description: The canonical authored agent package: one authored manifest (`agent.toml`) and the closed set of package-relative paths the folder contract recognizes. `files` is the digest map `apxm agent build` hashes into the generated `integrity.toml` chain, so the paths this schema recognizes and the paths that are hashed are one statement. A package declares no capability inventory and no permission inventory of its own: a Capability reference is satisfied by a built-in id or by a `capabilities/<id>/handler.ts` the package ships, and the only authored permission surface is the manifest's `[permissions]` table.

FileDigest.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file's bytes, as recorded in the integrity chain.

PermissionDecision.description: The closed three-value permission vocabulary, in the one wire form the machine publishes: a bare decision string, or an object carrying the reason declared beside it.

AgentManifest.description: `agent.toml` — the only authored manifest in the package. Every key is stated here; a key this schema does not name is a parse error, not a tolerated extra.

source.description: How the package's authored source is obtained. Carried verbatim; this schema states only that it is a table.

permissions.description: The package layer of the permission stack: what this package decides about a capability its own tree can supply. Tighten-only — it may narrow a decision and may never decide for a capability nothing grants.

CompileDeclaration.description: The package's single compiled entry. Both keys are stated together or neither is.

Hierarchy.description: This agent's parent and the children it may spawn or delegate to. Absorbed into the manifest; there is no separate `hierarchy.toml`.

PackageFiles.description: Every package-relative path the folder contract recognizes, mapped to the digest of its bytes. `patternProperties` is the sole authority: `apxm agent lint` and `verify_agent_integrity` both derive their recognized-path predicate from these patterns, so a path this object does not match is not part of the package.
